stem.text: Two balls P and Q, of equal mass, move along a straight line directly towards each other as shown.

stem.alt: Circles labelled P and Q, each with a horizontal velocity arrow above it. Arrow over P is labelled 1.30 m s−1 and points right; arrow over Q is labelled 0.50 m s−1 and points left.

stem.text: Ball P has velocity $1.30\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ to the right. Ball Q has velocity $0.50\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ to the left.
P and Q collide with one another. The collision is perfectly elastic and the total momentum is conserved.
Which diagram correctly shows the motion of P and Q after the collision?

A.alt: Circles labelled P and Q, each with a horizontal velocity arrow above it. Arrow over P is labelled 0.22 m s−1 and points right; arrow over Q is labelled 0.58 m s−1 and points right.

B.alt: Two touching circles labelled P and Q, with a horizontal velocity arrow above each. Both arrows are labelled 0.40 m s−1 and point right.

C.alt: Circles labelled P and Q, each with a horizontal velocity arrow above it. Arrow over P is labelled 0.19 m s−1 and points left; arrow over Q is labelled 0.99 m s−1 and points right.

D.alt: Circles labelled P and Q, each with a horizontal velocity arrow above it. Arrow over P is labelled 0.50 m s−1 and points left; arrow over Q is labelled 1.30 m s−1 and points right.
